steps.description:
At this point in the game, we can now obtain all but one **Gravestone**, which we will obtain just moments after beginning the next story section.

Here's how to find the remaining **Gravestones**...

**Dark Gravestone** (**Blue Castle**)
- You should've already picked this up.
- It was at the top of the tower in the **Blue Castle** where you fought **Yuri**.

**Fire Gravestone** (**Calios Mental Hospital**)
- You should've already picked this up.
- It was in the chest that you found the **Dungeon Key** in the **Calios Mental Hospital**.
- You had to examine it a second time to pick it up.

**Light Gravestone** (**Nemeton Monastery**)
- You will be able to pick this up in the first house you see to the left in the **Nemeton Monastery** once you start **W-2-12 - Nemeton Monastery (1)**. It'll be inside the house, past the vending machine.

**Air Gravestone** (**Prague**)
- Make your way to **Prague** and enter the bar.
- Talk to the Owner and he'll say that **Darcie**'s been in the bathroom for a while, so go into the men's room and examine the second stall.
- Watch the events here, and as long as you have some **Tissues** in your inventory, **Yuri** will give them to him to help him out.
- Attempt to leave the bar, and you'll receive the **Air Gravestone** as a thank you from him.
- Just make sure to wash it off, as well as your hands...

notes.title: Note
notes.text: If you don't want to waste a **Lottery Ticket** to get the **Tissues**, you can get some later on by winning the **Pit Fight** with **Margarete** (once it becomes available), or you can win them from the **Buggy** enemies in the **Cave Temple**.

steps.description:
**Earth Gravestone** (**Bistritz**)
1. Visit **Bistritz** and go to the right side of the village.
2. Examine the sparkling sprout outside of the shop, then go inside and talk to **Nina** to learn more about it.
3. Go back outside and examine it once again.
4. Answer with [1] Quietly watch over it.
- **Make sure to choose** 1!
- Once you do, leave **Bistritz**, then come back.
- Continue to choose 1 and leave the village, repeating the process until **Nina** is waiting for you beside the plant.
- Once she is, talk to her to receive the **Earth Gravestone**.

**Water Gravestone** (**Rouen**)
1. Take a trip to **Rouen** and go into the **Inn** and go up the stairs for a quick scene.
2. Go through the door on the right and talk to both **Indignant Mary** and **Upset John**, then make your way to the church and enter the confessional in the back.
3. **Upset John** will come in and ask you what you think he should do.
4. Answer with [2] It's about love, not the ring.
- Make sure to choose 2, otherwise you'll be forced to pay for the **Water Gravestone**, **3,000 Cash** if you choose 1, and **10,000 Cash** if you choose 3.
- In any case, once you can leave the church, head back to the **Inn** and into the room, where you'll find **John** and **Mary**.
- **John** will thank you for your words, and he'll give you the **Water Gravestone** as a thank you for saving his marriage.
- (If you chose 1, you'll have to pay **3,000 Cash**.)

choices.option: 1. Get her a diamond, as promised.
2. It's about love, not the ring.
3. Maybe it'd be better to split up.

notes.title: Note
notes.text: **Wild John** will be on the bottom-right of the first area if you chose 3 instead, and you can buy the **Gravestone** there.

notes.title: Missable event
notes.text:
- If you don't do this event now, you may not be able to later depending on how far you progress in the story.
- I strongly recommend doing it now, as you can miss out on a great accessory, as well as **Margarete**'s best weapon, if you don't.

steps.description: That's it for **Gravestones**, so make your way to the **Nemeton Monastery**!
